notes: Prices are P(dem_side wins): the Democratic candidate's chance; in races without a competitive Democrat the main independent is the dem_side (flagged in dem_side.aligned).

history: [time, Polymarket, Kalshi] every 30 minutes over the last 14 days; Polymarket = CLOB price history, Kalshi = hourly candles (mid if spread ≤ 10c, else last trade). Kalshi party markets pay on who is sworn in.
Senate control needs 51 seats, or 50 plus the Vice President's tie-breaking vote. holdovers = seats not up in 2026 (senate.gov); independents caucusing with Democrats are counted under I.
modeled = the race has the county-level election-night model (meta.races[].race_id).
